newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: DUNLOP YEAR EARNINGS DROP, DIVIDEND CUT.
newsitem.headline: DUNLOP YEAR EARNINGS DROP, DIVIDEND CUT.

text.p: Year to Dec 31
(all figures in Z$ million unless stated)
Shr (cts) 18.5 vs 27.7
Div (cts) 9.2 vs 11.7
Attrib 22.19 vs 33.19
Pre-tax 34.83 vs 56.01
Div payable June 6; on register April 25
Full name: Dunlop Zimbabwe Ltd
Note - The company said that recently announced tariff
reforms would go some way towards improving its profitability.
But Dunlop added that a considerable amount of tyres and
tubes had been imported prior to the announcement of the reforms
and it expected further volumes to be imported prior to the
effective date of the implementation of the new tariff regime.
This, it said, would lead to unsettled trading conditions during
the first half of the year.
Dunlop added that it expected to see improved prospects for
all stakeholders in 1997, particularly in the second half of the
year.
It said that for the first time since the introduction of
the new economic structural adjustment programme Dunlop would be
trading on a relatively level playing field against imported
competition from South Africa.
-- Harare newsroom +263-4 72 52 28/9
